              title: Household ID

                from the household's last name and address.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

I used exact-case matching to mirror the pinned reference table in the tests (`AcceptanceBase.CITY_REGION` is a case-sensitive `Map.of(...).getOrDefault(city, "UNKNOWN")`). Since `locality` is read-only and derived from `city`, no entity field, database column, or reverse mapping was needed.
